description: How JSON-LD 1.1 types a property value (Object to RDF Conversion, steps 10 and 11):
a plain number is an xsd:double only with a non-zero fractional part or an absolute
value of at least 10^21, every other plain number an xsd:integer; a declared @type
decides; a string is an xsd:string. 'json' is the value as written in the model,
'datatype' the local name of the XSD type it must have once read, 'number' its value
where it is a number. Shared by shacl2flink and the SemForge SDK (#958, design D3):
both read models with this table as the reference.
1e18 stands in for a large whole number: rdflib reads JSON integers beyond 64 bits
as doubles, so 1e20 cannot be read as the integer the standard makes of it.
